reasoning_content:
The stack is coming up. MinIO is healthy (my custom image works). Let me wait for the full infrastructure to be ready.

The compose is up and running. MinIO is showing as healthy (my custom-built image is working!). I'll wait for all the services, including Keycloak and Postgres, to become healthy.

action.command:
cd /workspace
# Wait for compose up --wait to finish (it blocks until healthy)
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  if [ -f /tmp/compose-up.done ]; then break; fi
  sleep 5
done
echo "=== compose-up.done ==="; cat /tmp/compose-up.done 2>/dev/null || echo "(still waiting)"
echo "=== compose up log tail ==="; tail -20 /tmp/compose-up.log
echo "=== container status ==="; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}"
